triggerTitle: Agent Warden: view and edit agent behavior limits
modelGroupsHint: Only affects newly created child agents; empty means default
fieldLeadExecute: Lead does not execute tasks directly
leadExecuteHint: The Lead cannot read, grep, glob, write, edit or str_replace_editor; only paths the user explicitly referenced in their message (@, backticks, or absolute paths) are readable; verification commands (tsc / build / test / git diff) are allowed; investigation and execution both go to subagents.
leadSchedulingHint: While the guard is on, the main session carries this scheduling protocol in every request.
contractHint: Every subagent request carries this contract; edits or context compaction re-sync it.
leadReminderHint: The main session gets this reminder once per turn, only with the Lead gate on.
textDefaultHint: Leave empty to use the built-in English default
promptDefaultHint: Leave empty and save to use the built-in English default
settingsUnavailable: Settings are unavailable (the Host does not serve agent-guard); view only.
hint: Applied as soon as you save.
